is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus alongside Culex species (page 5, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports the West Africa kdr allele (L995F) in Culex quinquefasciatus (page 2, 8, 10).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 on page 10 provides genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for the kdr mutation in Culex quinquefasciatus.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 3, 4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection and laboratory analysis of mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in 32 districts of Yaoundé, Cameroon (page 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted from March to December 2017 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection of mosquitoes in 2017.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the distribution, insecticide susceptibility, and role in lymphatic filariasis transmission of Culex mosquitoes in Yaoundé, Cameroon. It reports high resistance to DDT, permethrin, and deltamethrin in Culex species and provides genotype counts for the West Africa kdr (L995F) mutation in Culex quinquefasciatus.
